name: @fabianmossberg/fabpix-core
description: Shared core for fabpix: photo providers (Pexels, Unsplash), settings, download manifest
author: Fabian Mossberg

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/index.ts --target=node --outdir=dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && find dist -name '*.d.ts' -exec sed -i.bak 's/\.ts";/.js";/g' {} + && find dist -name '*.bak' -delete
